verdict.rationale: Delaware documents a machine-readable bulk channel: 1099 XML files submitted through the DE Taxpayer Portal using IRS IRIS schemas. It also has a "For Tax Software Developers" section. However, the evidence shows only file upload through an authenticated portal, and no transmitter or developer enrollment process is documented. Missing for 10: a published transmitter/batch-provider enrollment path, system-account or API credentials for software-to-service transactions, coverage beyond 1099 files, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, a documented system-to-system channel exists for software to transact with the service (system accounts, transmitter programs, batch providers), with the enrollment path published

citations.quote: Only the 1099 XML file format will be accepted via the DE Taxpayer Portal.
Division of Revenue will follow the same schema formats as the IRS, available on the IRS IRIS website.
